page.overview:
Who is Quetzalli?

Quetzalli , also known as Palidor or Kixaihih, is a recurring creature in the Final Fantasy series. It debuted as an esper in Final Fantasy VI.

Quetzalli (originally translated as Palidor in the SNES Final Fantasy III release) is an esper obtained by returning to the Solitary Island after obtaining the Falcon and returning to the beach. Its summon attack, Sonic Dive, allows the entire party to perform a Jump attack. It costs 61 MP to summon. It teaches Slow (x20), Haste (x20), Slowga (x2), Hastega (x2) and Float (x5).

The Quetzalli is a Notorious Monster of the Roc family that appears in Abyssea - Tahrongi in the Vision of Abyssea expansion. It casts spells such as Fire V, Firaga IV, and Flare, and uses Benediction repeatedly throughout the battle, fully recovering all HP.

Kixaihih is a great bird worshiped by the Hanuhanu, a people living in Kozama'uka. Although its English name is different from Quetzalli's, they both have the same Japanese name.
